snippet.title: Throne of Valoria | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Throne of Valoria is finally available to wishlist on Steam via the link below:
-
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3335040/Throne_of_Valoria/?beta=0
-
This is a 2 man project that has been in the works for nearly a year now. We wanted to get a Steam page out as soon as possible to continue to grow our fanbase, and it was highly requested that we did so!

This stands as a reveal trailer, so a lot of the content seen may change over time, and things will get added as the project goes on. We intend on releasing more in depth gameplay and mechanical trailers in the near future, but while polish is still underway, this serves as an accurate representation of the game at it's core.

Be sure to follow our socials below to stay up to date:
TiktTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@throneofvaloria
X - https://x.com/throneofvaloria
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/throneofvaloria/
Discord - https://linktr.ee/throneofvaloria
Kickstarter - https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/throneofvaloria/throne-of-valoria

Find the music used in the trailer linked below:
Alexandr Zhelanov, 'Betrayed' https://soundcloud.com/alexandr-zhelanov
